notes:
Design Engineering Tip: Visual cues reduce uncertainty. Instead of making users guess why an action isn't available, communicate it through motion. A small shake instantly signals "not yet" without interrupting the flow. css .locked:hover{ animation:shake .28s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); }

Designer: @gabriell_lab. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
